description: This Java class 'ProductPriceUtils' provides utility methods for handling product pricing calculations, formatting currency amounts, applying discounts, and retrieving product prices within an e-commerce system. It includes functions for price retrieval, final price calculation considering attributes and discounts, and various currency formatting methods.

classes.name: ProductPriceUtils
classes.description: Utility class for managing product pricing, formatting, and discount calculations in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the default price for a given product from its availability options.

methods.name: getFinalProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final product price including selected attributes, based on the default price.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the overall final price for a product, factoring in product attributes and discounts.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a raw string suitable for admin input, following locale-specific decimal formatting.

methods.name: getStoreFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a price amount into a currency string according to store settings, either national or international format.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a price amount into a currency string based on a specific locale and currency.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats an amount with store currency into a string suitable for admin display.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats an amount with a specific currency into a string based on locale.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Parses a formatted price string into a BigDecimal, handling locale-specific formatting and validation.

methods.name: getOrderProductTotalPrice
methods.description: Calculates total price for an order product based on quantity and unit price.

methods.name: hasDiscount
methods.description: Determines whether a given ProductPrice has an active discount based on current date and discount validity period.
